verdict.rationale: Gusto has a separate sandbox environment at api.gusto-demo.com, distinct from production at api.gusto.com. The first-party CLI gives each environment its own credential slot via `--env sandbox` versus `--env production`. Demo companies are auto-generated with company info, employees and past payrolls so testing can start without real data. Missing for 10: a dedicated sandbox guide in the pack (account provisioning, data reset/seeding, behavioral differences from production), explicit coverage of sandbox for the Embedded Payroll API beyond the CLI, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
